snippet.title: Redd's Runaway - Announcement Trailer [itch.io]
snippet.description:
This is a tale about pain, suffering, and vengeance; about hope, compassion, and mercy.

Inspired by the Red Ridding Hood's tale, Redd's Runaway is an indie run and gun action game, combining a frenetic playstyle with an aesthetic reminiscent of the traditions of Halloween and the Day of the Dead, in a short experience aiming for a great replayability.

For more information, visit us at: https://bewolfstudio.com/

Music: Avenger by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio - https://youtu.be/YxUx3DYZJ1w
